# Review 3 — Presentation Materials

**Stage:** Review 3 (final report, 10 marks)
**Delivered deck:** `VARSA_Review_3.pptx` (root of the repository), generated by
`scripts/make_review3_ppt.py` — run it *after* `scripts/final_analysis.py` (it embeds
the figures from `review_3/` and reads `review_3/analysis_results.json`).

---

| Slide | Content |
|---|---|
| 1 | Title slide (project name, team, date) |

---

## 2. Slide Guidelines

- Max 1 idea per slide ✓ (one figure + one claim per findings slide)
- 24pt+ body, 22–26pt titles (footer/caption text smaller by design)
- Figures: high resolution (200 dpi PNG), labelled, no clutter ✓
- Text: ~20% text, 80% figures/visuals ✓ (six embedded figures + stat cards)
- Practice timing: ~1 min per slide → ~15 minutes + Q&A
